simple.meaning: פּוּרָה (pûwrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a wine-press (as crushing the grapes).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 63:3. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פּוּרָה (H6333) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H6333. puwrah מּוּרָה noun feminine wine-press ; — ׳פ דָּרַכְתִּי Isa 63:3 (see דָּרַךְ 3 ; distinguished from יֶקֶב , and perhaps part of it, Hag 2:16 (reading ׳מִמּ , so Sm Now; usually measure of juice from one filling of the ׳פ , see Ke).

occurrences.englishText: “I have trodden the wine press alone.
Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.
